state_source: preset/tone/motion/volume plus renderer clock; audio and shape derive from the same preset

preset.interruption: new interpolation starts from current weights

controls.motion: mesh deformation, LFO depth/rate and delay wet gain

pause.raf: one pending/explicit input frame then no continuous RAF

visibility.hidden: cancel pending RAF and fade/close audio
visibility.visible: restart graphics clock without hidden dt; audio stays stopped

resize.canvas: actual host rectangle with bounded DPR
resize.mobile: stacked hero, smaller mesh selected on initial load

scroll_moment.reason: v1 baseline; planned improvement is the instrument/shape spatial continuity

fallback.no_webgl: original SVG plus functional audio controls

diagnostics.telemetry: 20-second raw active render intervals; not clamped dt; LCP/CLS observers
